title.en: An Act to Authorize an Appropriation for the Development of the Mindanao State University, and for Other Purposes
title.orig: An Act to Authorize an Appropriation for the Development of the Mindanao State University, and for Other Purposes

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1964/ra_4108_1964.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The sum of fifteen million pesos is hereby authorized to be appropriated out of any funds in the National Treasury not otherwise appropriated, to be made available to the Mindanao State University at the rate of three million pesos annually beginning the fiscal year nineteen hundred and sixty-five, to support its development, including capital outlay for permanent improvements and for other purposes at the discretion of its Board of Regents: Provided, That any amount of the said fifteen million pesos not released to the University after five years shall continue to be made available until the whole amount appropriated shall have been used by the University, any provision of law to the contrary notwithstanding.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 19, 1964.
